name: Dunbar & Seo Longcoat
description: Dunbar & Seo is old money in the GLMZ tailoring world — a label that has been producing bespoke and ready-to-wear at the high end of the market for four decades, long enough to have dressed three generations of Tier 4 and Tier 5 families. The Longcoat is their statement outerwear piece: a floor-length structured coat in a cashmere-wool blend that is available in six house colors and can be ordered in any color with sufficient lead time. The silhouette is severe and intentional — high collar, clean front placket with concealed closures, minimal surface detail, and a cut that falls straight from shoulder to hem with an almost architectural rigidity. It is the coat of a person who has decided that their outerwear does not need to explain itself. Tier 5 clients order these in volume; Tier 4 clients save for one and wear it for a decade. The ready-to-wear line starts at Φ1,200; fully bespoke begins at Φ4,000 and climbs from there.
what_it_says: You do not need to display wealth through logos or embellishment. The material, the cut, and the silence of the design communicate everything that needs to be communicated to the people whose opinions you value.
worn_by: anyone who wants to look expensive without looking like they are trying to look expensive
story_hooks: Dunbar & Seo maintains a private archive of every bespoke commission going back forty years — the archive contains measurements, fabric swatches, and correspondence that amounts to a biographical record of GLMZ's elite, and someone has recently attempted to access it without authorization

A Dunbar & Seo Longcoat in an unregistered colorway — a deep red that does not appear in any catalog — has been photographed at three separate high-profile events, always on a figure whose face is not clearly captured

The label's current co-director, the Seo half of the partnership, has been quietly taking on clients from outside the traditional Tier 4-5 social world — there is gossip in the Spire about who is being dressed and why
